rules: No Inter, Roboto, or generic sans for headings.
Headings > 32px MUST use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Use heavy weights (Bold/Black) for Main Landing Headings to show authority.
Use JetBrains Mono for Chatbot timestamps, Admin Dashboard data, and bot source links.

landing_page.details: Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with wide gaps (gap-12). Create visual tension by offsetting elements. Use generous padding (p-12 to p-24) for sections. Do not center everything; rely on strong left alignments and overlapping images.

chat_widget.details: Bottom-right fixed trigger. Opens into a compact drawer/modal. Uses backdrop-blur-2xl and bg-black/60. MUST NOT use full screen takeover on desktop. Include quick-reply chips and source links styled as pill buttons.

admin_dashboard.strategy: High Density Grid - Mode B + Grid Borders
admin_dashboard.details: Dense layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6). Use flat solid backgrounds for cards with a 1px technical border (border-border/40). Expose the skeleton of the UI. Highly legible, no decorative gradients.

visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md) with sharp hover transitions. Primary actions in Safety Orange (#FF5722).
visual_enhancers.grain_overlay: Implement a subtle SVG noise/grain over the main hero landing section to remove 'digital flatness'.

components.landing_hero: Dark oceanic background image with bg-[#020813]/60 overlay. Massive typography. Clear CTA to explore courses.
components.chat_trigger: Circular floating button in Safety Orange or AI Cyan, featuring an unread indicator dot and subtle pulse animation.
components.chat_bubble_user: Flat solid styling, aligned right, bg-white/10.
components.chat_bubble_bot: Flat solid styling, aligned left, subtle cyan border left (border-l-2 border-[#00E5FF]).
components.admin_table: Shadcn Table customized with JetBrains Mono for data cells, technical grid borders, status badges for grounded/fallback responses.

motion.chat_widget: Framer motion scale-up from bottom-right origin on open.
motion.typing_indicator: Three dots bouncing sequence in bot bubble.
motion.page_scroll: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling on the landing page.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images uses text-shadow or heavy gradient overlays (e.g., bg-black/60) to meet APCA contrast standards.
accessibility.focus: All inputs and buttons MUST have high-contrast focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00E5FF]).
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the chat widget expansion and typing indicators.

hero_background.description: Moody, dark ocean surface with dramatic waves. Use as the main landing page hero background.

programs_overview.description: Aerial view of a cargo ship on the ocean. Use in the Programs or About HIMT section.

training_simulation.description: Ship captain in the control room overlooking a cargo ship. Use for training/facilities highlight.

students_campus.description: Students in white maritime uniform. Use for the Admissions or Campus Life section.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Not strictly required, but TSParticles can be used in the hero background to simulate subtle ocean spray or data nodes (AI chatbot connection) without overwhelming the UX.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a JavaScript (.js) project. DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx) files or syntax.
Use standard HTML+Tailwind for the landing page to allow for creative, asymmetrical bento-box layouts.
Use Shadcn UI components for the chat widget logic, form inputs, and the dense admin dashboard.
Implement the Chat Widget as a fixed container (bottom-right) that toggles a conversational modal with Framer Motion.
Include 'Source Link' chips inside the bot's chat bubbles to show where the retrieved data came from.
For the Admin Dashboard, create a table view for chat logs containing Query, Answer, Timestamp, and Status (Grounded vs Fallback).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like robot/brain for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. ALWAYS USE THE PROVIDED IMAGE URLS.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Always ensure a strong visible hierarchy. The most important action should instantly draw the eye.
Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Hover state color must be a lighter hue of ACTIVE state color. ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover.
Do not use complete transparent background in headers or overlays over content.
